name: Tadalafil
sections: White crystalline powder, practically insoluble in water.

Approved for ED (2003), pulmonary arterial hypertension (2009) and BPH (2011); onset ~30 minutes, duration up to 36 hours. First approval/introduction: Discovered by Glaxo Wellcome/ICOS (1991–94); EU 2002, US FDA 2003 (Lilly ICOS).

Selectively inhibits PDE-5, increasing cGMP in corpus cavernosum smooth muscle and enhancing nitric oxide-mediated erection upon sexual stimulation; also relaxes prostate and bladder smooth muscle (BPH symptoms). Long duration of action (up to 36 h). Receptor / target profile: Selective PDE5 inhibitor; greater PDE11 but less PDE6 (retinal) and PDE1 inhibition than sildenafil or vardenafil.
Not determined (well absorbed; not affected by food)
Hepatic – CYP3A4 to inactive catechol and methylcatechol glucuronide
Summary: Tmax ~2 h; unaffected by food. ~94% protein bound. Metabolised by CYP3A4. Half-life 17.5 h.
Signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (with or without ED) – 5 mg daily
Pulmonary arterial hypertension (specific 20 mg formulation, specialist use)
ED on-demand: 10 mg at least 30 minutes before sexual activity; may increase to 20 mg; max once daily
ED once-daily: 2.5–5 mg at the same time each day
CrCl 30–50: on-demand max 10 mg every 48 h; CrCl <30: on-demand max 5 mg, daily dosing not recommended
Dose to be individualised by the treating physician according to clinical response and tolerability.
CrCl 30–50: on-demand max 10 mg/48 h, daily 5 mg max; <30: on-demand max 5 mg/72 h, daily not recommended.
Child-Pugh A–B: on-demand max 10 mg; C: not recommended.
Not indicated (PAH formulations at specialist level).
Concomitant nitrates (any form) or riociguat – severe hypotension
Recent MI (within 90 days), unstable angina or angina during intercourse
Heart failure NYHA ≥2 within 6 months, uncontrolled arrhythmias, hypotension (<90/50) or uncontrolled hypertension
Sudden vision or hearing loss – stop and seek attention
Penile anatomical deformity, conditions predisposing to priapism (sickle cell, myeloma, leukaemia)
Alpha-blockers (additive hypotension) – start at low dose when stable
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, ritonavir) – max 10 mg/72 h (on-demand)
With or without food; limit alcohol (≥5 units causes hypotension).
Headache, back pain, hypotension. Supportive care; not dialysable.
Porst et al., Eur Urol 2011 – tadalafil 5 mg daily improved LUTS/BPH and ED.
Multiple RCTs establish efficacy in ED with a 36-hour window of responsiveness.
Never take with nitrate medicines (isosorbide dinitrate/mononitrate, nitroglycerin)
Seek urgent help for erection >4 hours
Report sudden vision or hearing loss
Store below 30°C in a dry place, protected from light and moisture. Keep out of the reach of children. Do not use after the expiry date.
